blocks.text: Jandaron (living organisms) ki classification ek hierarchical system (darja ba darja tarteeb) mein ki jati hai. Is se scientists jandaron ko groups mein rakh sakte hain aur zindagi ki mukhtalif shaklon ke aapas ke rishte samajh sakte hain. Is system mein kai levels hote hain jinhein taxa kehte hain (wahid: taxon); har taxon biological classification ka ek rank (darja) hai. Is hierarchy ke buniyadi levels yeh hain: kingdom, phylum, class, order, family, genus aur species. Neeche har level ko tafseel se bayan kiya gaya hai.

blocks.title: Taxon aur taxonomic hierarchy
blocks.text: Taxon classification ka koi ek rank ya level hai, jaise family ya genus. Taxonomic hierarchy in ranks ki seerhi (ladder) hai: sab se bare group (domain) se sab se chhote aur khaas group (species) tak. Jaise jaise neeche jaate hain, har group ke jandar aapas mein zyada milte julte hote jaate hain.

blocks.alt: Taxonomic hierarchy nau (9) ek doosre ke neeche latakti ghanti-numa (bell) satahon ki shakal mein: sab se upar All Organisms, phir Domain, Kingdom, Phylum, Class, Order, Family, Genus, aur sab se neeche Species. Har satah ke saath us ka naam ek khaane mein likha hai.
blocks.caption: Figure 1.5: Taxonomic hierarchy (kitab ki Figure 1.5 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Upar se neeche parhein. Sab se upar All Organisms, yani tamam jandar, hain. Har agla rank apne se upar wale rank ke andar se nikalta hai aur us mein kam jandar hote hain. Domain sab se bara (broadest) rank hai aur Species sab se khaas (most specific): ek species sirf ek qisam ke jandar ki hoti hai. Har ghanti ke neeche ke soorakh dikhate hain ke ek bara group kai chhote groups mein batta hai.
1. Domain
Yeh classification ka sab se ooncha level hai. Is waqt teen domains hain: Archaea, Bacteria aur Eukarya.
2. Kingdom
Kingdom sab se oonche ranks mein se ek hai, domain se bilkul neeche. Yeh un tamam jandaron ko ek group mein rakhta hai jin ki buniyadi khasoosiyat (characteristics) ek jaisi hain.

items: Misal: domain Eukarya mein kai kingdoms hain, jaise Animalia (janwar), Plantae (poday), Fungi (fungi) aur Protista (protists).

blocks.text: 3. Phylum
Phylum kingdom se neeche agla level hai. Ek phylum ke jandaron ka buniyadi body plan (jism ka naqsha) aur aham structural features (banawat ki khasoosiyat) ek jaise hote hain.

items: Misal: kingdom Animalia mein phylum Chordata un tamam janwaron ko shamil karta hai jin mein notochord hota hai, jaise mammals, birds (parinde), reptiles, amphibians aur fish (machhliyan).

blocks.text: 4. Class
Class ek phylum ke jandaron ko zyada khaas milti julti khasoosiyat (common traits) ki buniyad par mazeed groups mein baant deti hai.

items: Misal: phylum Chordata ke andar class Mammalia mein tamam mammals aate hain, jin ki pehchaan jism par baal (hair) aur mammary glands (doodh banane wale glands) hain.

blocks.text: 5. Order
Order ek class ke jandaron ko mazeed milti julti khasoosiyat aur evolutionary history (nasal ki tareekh) ki buniyad par groups mein rakhta hai.

items: Misal: class Mammalia ke andar order Primates mein insaan, bandar (monkeys) aur apes aate hain, jin ki pehchaan bara dimagh aur opposable thumbs (aisa angootha jo baqi ungliyon ke saamne mur sake) hain.

blocks.text: 6. Family
Family ek order ke un jandaron ko ek group mein rakhti hai jo aur bhi qareebi rishtedar hain aur jin ki khasoosiyat aur bhi zyada milti hain.

items: Misal: order Primates ke andar family Hominidae mein great apes (bare bandar, jaise gorilla aur chimpanzee) aur insaan shamil hain.

blocks.text: 7. Genus
Genus family ke andar ek zyada khaas rank hai. Is mein woh species aati hain jo bohat qareebi rishtedar hain aur aksar dekhne mein bhi milti julti hain.

items: Misal: family Hominidae ke andar genus Homo mein insaan aur hamare sab se qareebi extinct (khatam ho chuke) rishtedar shamil hain.

blocks.text: 8. Species

Species classification ka sab se khaas level hai, jo jandar ki sirf ek qisam ko zahir karta hai. Ek species ke afraad aapas mein interbreed (milap se bachay paida) kar sakte hain aur fertile offspring (aisi aulad jo aage khud bhi bachay paida kar sake) paida karte hain.

items: Misal: genus Homo ke andar species Homo sapiens aaj ke insaan hain.

blocks.title: Tarteeb yaad rakhne ka tareeqa
blocks.text: Domain, Kingdom, Phylum, Class, Order, Family, Genus, Species: pehle huroof D-K-P-C-O-F-G-S hain. Har rank apne se neeche wale rank ko apne andar rakhta hai, aur neeche jaate hue har group mein jandaron ki tadaad kam hoti jaati hai.

blocks.caption: Insaan, chiriya (sparrow) aur pyaaz (onion) ke taxonomic ranks

blocks.text: Table ko upar se neeche (ek column) parhein to ek jandar ki poori classification milti hai. Ek row ko daayein baayein parhein to teenon jandaron ka ek hi rank par muqabla (comparison) hota hai. Insaan aur chiriya phylum Chordata tak sab kuch share karte hain aur class par alag hote hain. Pyaaz kingdom par hi dono se alag ho jata hai, kyunke woh poda hai. Species ka naam do hisson ka hota hai: pehle genus (bare harf se), phir species ka lafz, jaise Homo sapiens.

blocks.title: Classification parhna
blocks.problem: In teen jandaron mein se kaun se do sab se qareebi rishtedar hain, aur kis rank par woh alag ho jate hain?
steps: Columns ko upar se milayein. Insaan, chiriya aur pyaaz teenon domain Eukarya mein hain.
Kingdom par insaan aur chiriya dono Animalia hain; pyaaz Plantae hai. Is liye pyaaz sab se door ka rishtedar hai.
Insaan aur chiriya dono phylum Chordata mein hain, lekin class par insaan Mammalia hai aur chiriya Aves.
blocks.answer: Insaan aur chiriya sab se qareebi rishtedar hain. Un ka domain, kingdom aur phylum ek hai, aur woh class ke rank par alag hote hain.

blocks.text: Mukhtasar khulasa

items: Taxon classification ka ek rank hai (jama: taxa); taxonomic hierarchy in ranks ki seerhi hai.
Sab se bare se sab se khaas tak: domain, kingdom, phylum, class, order, family, genus, species.
Domain sab se ooncha rank hai (Archaea, Bacteria, Eukarya); species sab se khaas: ek qisam ke jandar jo aapas mein interbreed kar ke fertile offspring paida karte hain.
Insaan: Eukarya, Animalia, Chordata, Mammalia, Primates, Hominidae, Homo, Homo sapiens.

blocks.prompt: Aath ranks tarteeb se likhein, phir ghar ki chiriya (house sparrow) ka class aur order batayein.
blocks.explanation: Domain, kingdom, phylum, class, order, family, genus, species. Chiriya class Aves aur order Passeriformes mein hai.
